svg.title: BOKI character modeling handoff
svg.text: BOKI / MODELING HANDOFF V2 · PROPOSED ART SPEC
Blender shape reference + editable construction notes / Unity 6000.6.7f1 target
M_Boki_Body: jacket, trousers, shoes and hands in
M_Boki_Head: face + ears; hair can join the head
M_Watch: rigid left-wrist prop; digits are texture
No body geometry beneath fully closed clothing.
Mirror the body before asymmetrical watch and
Add bend rings at shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip,
Keep jacket armpit open enough for the riding
One shared palm + thumb is enough; no individual
Retain normals on broad planes; soften only
Boki_RideIdle — looping, fixed feet and hand
Boki_Steer_L/R — optional lean poses, visual only.
Boki_Boost — optional crouch; no root translation.
Generic rig first for bespoke jam
CameraPivot stays outside the animated skeleton.
Unity +X right / +Y up / +Z forward · meters · all new art sizes and budgets are proposals.
Generated artwork is raster reference; notes/diagrams are editable vectors. Meshes, rigs and integration are future work.
Canonical rules: docs/Story.md + docs/Gameplay.md · practical import and wiring: UNITY_HANDOFF.md
